scopes.name: wave
scopes.description: The `wave` scope provides advanced configuration for the use of [Wave containers](https://docs.seqera.io/wave).

children.name: build
children.description: The `wave` scope provides advanced configuration for the use of [Wave containers](https://docs.seqera.io/wave).

children.name: cacheRepository
children.description: The container repository used to cache image layers built by the Wave service.

children.name: compression
children.description: The `wave.build.compression` scope controls compression of the container image built by Wave.

children.name: force
children.description: Forcefully apply the compression option to all layers, including already existing layers (default: `false`).

children.name: level
children.description: The compression level used when building a container, depending on the chosen algorithm: gzip and estargz (0-9), zstd (0-22).

children.name: mode
children.description: The compression algorithm used when building the container. Allowed values are `gzip`, `estargz` and `zstd` (default: `gzip`).

children.name: conda
children.description: The `wave.build.conda` scope controls how Conda packages are provisioned into containers.

children.name: baseImage
children.description: The base image for the final stage in multi-stage Conda container builds (default: `ubuntu:24.04`). This option only applies when `wave.build.template` is set to `conda/micromamba:v2`, `conda/micromamba:v2-fast`, `conda/pixi:v1` or `conda/pixi:v1-fast`.

children.name: basePackages
children.description: One or more Conda packages to be always added in the resulting container (default: `conda-forge::procps-ng`).

children.name: commands
children.description: One or more commands to be added to the Dockerfile used to build a Conda based image.

children.name: mambaImage
children.description: The Mamba container image used to build Conda based containers. This is expected to be a [micromamba-docker](https://github.com/mamba-org/micromamba-docker) image.

children.name: repository
children.description: The container repository where images built by Wave are uploaded.

children.name: template
children.description: The build template to use for container builds. Supported values: `conda/pixi:v1` (Pixi with multi-stage builds), `conda/pixi:v1-fast` (like `conda/pixi:v1`, with the Conda environment split into multiple image layers, Docker only), `conda/micromamba:v2` (Micromamba 2.x with multi-stage builds), `conda/micromamba:v2-fast` (like `conda/micromamba:v2`, with the Conda environment split into multiple image layers, Docker only), `cran/installr:v1` (R/CRAN packages). Default: standard conda/micromamba:v1 template.

children.name: enabled
children.description: Enable the use of Wave containers (default: `false`).

children.name: endpoint
children.description: The Wave service endpoint (default: `https://wave.seqera.io`).

children.name: freeze
children.description:
Enable Wave container freezing (default: `false`). Wave will provision a non-ephemeral container image that will be pushed to a container repository of your choice.

See also: `wave.build.repository` and `wave.build.cacheRepository`

children.name: httpClient
children.description: The `wave` scope provides advanced configuration for the use of [Wave containers](https://docs.seqera.io/wave).

children.name: connectTimeout
children.description: The connection timeout for the Wave HTTP client (default: `30s`).

children.name: maxRate
children.description: The maximum request rate for the Wave HTTP client (default: `1/sec`).

children.name: mirror
children.description:
Enable Wave container mirroring (default: `false`). Wave will mirror (i.e. copy) the containers in your pipeline to a container registry of your choice, so that pipeline tasks can pull the containers from this registry instead of the original one.

See also: `wave.build.repository`

children.name: retryPolicy
children.description: The `wave` scope provides advanced configuration for the use of [Wave containers](https://docs.seqera.io/wave).

children.name: delay
children.description: The initial delay when a failing HTTP request is retried (default: `450ms`).

children.name: jitter
children.description: The jitter factor used to randomly vary retry delays (default: `0.25`).

children.name: maxAttempts
children.description: The max number of attempts a failing HTTP request is retried (default: `5`).

children.name: maxDelay
children.description: The max delay when a failing HTTP request is retried (default: `90s`).

children.name: multiplier
children.description: The multiplier used for exponential backoff delay calculations (default: `2.0`)

children.name: scan
children.description: The `wave` scope provides advanced configuration for the use of [Wave containers](https://docs.seqera.io/wave).

children.name: allowedLevels
children.description: Comma-separated list of allowed vulnerability levels when scanning containers for security vulnerabilities in `required` mode.

children.name: mode
children.description: Enable Wave container security scanning. Wave will scan the containers in your pipeline for security vulnerabilities.

children.name: strategy
children.description: The strategy to be used when resolving multiple Wave container requirements (default: `'container,dockerfile,conda'`).

scopes.name: workDir
scopes.description: The pipeline work directory. Equivalent to the `-work-dir` option of the `run` command.

scopes.name: workflow
scopes.description: The `workflow` scope provides workflow execution options.

children.name: failOnIgnore
children.description: When `true`, the pipeline will exit with a non-zero exit code if any failed tasks are ignored using the `ignore` error strategy (default: `false`).

children.name: onComplete
children.description: Specify a closure that will be invoked at the end of a workflow run (including failed runs).

children.name: onError
children.description: Specify a closure that will be invoked if a workflow run is terminated.

children.name: output
children.description:
The `workflow.output` scope provides options for publishing workflow outputs.

[Read more](https://docs.seqera.io/nextflow/reference/config/workflow)

children.name: contentType
children.description:
*Currently only supported for S3.*

Specify the media type, also known as [MIME type](https://developer.mozilla.org/en-US/docs/Web/HTTP/MIME_types), of published files (default: `false`). Can be a string (e.g. `'text/html'`), or `true` to infer the content type from the file extension.

children.name: copyAttributes
children.description:
*Currently only supported for local and shared filesystems.*

Copy file attributes (such as the last modified timestamp) to the published file (default: `false`).

children.name: enabled
children.description: Enable or disable publishing (default: `true`).

children.name: ignoreErrors
children.description: When `true`, the workflow will not fail if a file can't be published for some reason (default: `false`).

children.name: includeInputs
children.description: When `true`, files that do not originate from the work directory, such as input files, are also published (default: `false`).

children.name: mode
children.description: The file publishing method (default: `'symlink'`).

children.name: overwrite
children.description: Determines when to overwrite an existing file in the output directory (default: `'standard'`).

children.name: storageClass
children.description:
*Currently only supported for S3.*

Specify the storage class for published files.

children.name: tags
children.description:
*Currently only supported for S3.*

Specify arbitrary tags for published files.
